name: EKanbanLoopBoard
tagline: Pull replenishment you can see: every kanban loop, every card, every late signal.
description: Manufacturing e-Kanban board for Canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages: card states (full, empty signal, in replenishment, hold), red/yellow/green loop signals against lead-time cover, late and waiting cards, KPIs and a kanban loop sizing calculator that adds or retires cards.
features: Loops × card states board with card age
Red/yellow/green signals from lead-time and safety cover
KPI strip with days of cover
Loop sizing N = ⌈D × LT × (1 + SF) ÷ Q⌉ with apply/reset
Phone and tablet layouts, keyboard shortcuts
signalsJson / sizingJson outputs and browser event
